issue.title: Inline task mentions on 🪢 LINKED FROM
issue.description: When one task's own text links another task (`[[note#^id]]`, embedded or struck too), the target's generated 🪢 LINKED FROM line gains an inert `[[S]] (💬 mentions)` entry that explains itself at a glance with a `💬 mentioned in` / `💬 embedded in` pill, a live quote, and a context card that jumps to the sentence. Nothing is written on the mentioning task except a silent `^id`, a dependency or relation on the pair wins, and Rust and both plugins agree on every shared vector.
